source.title: What is a credit score?

Usually a higher score makes it easier to qualify for a loan and may result in a better interest rate or loan terms. Most credit scores range from 300-850.

"And new data from the 2023 ACS, 1-year estimates show that the share of a rented household's income that goes towards these housing costs differs by householder race."
